## Host Memory Utilization High - Warning Alert

**Severity:** WARNING

The host's memory utilization has exceeded the threshold. The host is the VM (the resource envelope the containers run inside), not the physical host; on GCP it is the GCE node. High host memory means the containers are close to exhausting the VM's RAM and may start to swap or get OOM-killed.

### Threshold note
`TODO: tune` - placeholder is 0.85 (85%). Adjust once we have a baseline from the Resource Usage dashboard.

### Metric name note
This uses the GMP-rendered name of the `hostmetrics` receiver's `system.memory.utilization` metric (a ratio, unit `1`, so typically no unit suffix). The exact rendered name is confirmed post-deploy via `gcloud monitoring metrics list` and may need adjustment.

### Triage
1. Check `Resource Usage` dashboard - host memory utilization + per-container memory.
2. Identify the container(s) consuming the most memory.
3. Right-size services or grow the VM if usage is legitimate.

### Runbook
See `docs/RUNBOOKS.md` -> Infrastructure section.
